text: The supplier must hold a valid LUSA qualification for the relevant field.
The supplier must hold valid liability insurance with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
The supplier must have at least 20 HVAC (LVI) professionals in its own employment.
The supplier's turnover in its most recent financial year must be at least EUR 5,000,000.
The quotation shall include a site-specific occupational safety plan.
The quotation shall describe the condition-monitoring data the supplier collects during maintenance visits and how it is reported back to the buyer.
The quotation shall describe how environmental matters are managed during the works.
The quotation shall describe the supplier's quality-control and testing procedures.
The quotation shall include a preventive maintenance plan for the systems covered by this contract.
The quotation shall describe the content of the proposed HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement.
The quotation shall describe the qualification requirements applied to personnel working on site.
The quotation shall confirm compatibility with the buyer's building automation system, which operates on BACnet/Modbus.
The quotation shall describe the content and scheduling of routine maintenance visits.
The quotation shall state the service-level targets (SLA) offered for each of the three sites.
The quotation shall state the proposed contract period and any extension options offered.
The quotation shall state the supplier's proposed limitation-of-liability clause.
The quotation shall describe any bonus/malus arrangement proposed against the service levels in Section 4.
The quotation shall state the proposed pricing structure (fixed price / unit price / time-and-materials).
A list of subcontractors (Liite 3) shall be included with the quotation.
A completed Reference Form (Liite 2) shall be included with the quotation.
The minimum font size used in the quotation shall be 11pt.
The quotation shall state the reference currency used for pricing under this framework agreement.
The quotation document shall not exceed 20 pages, excluding appendices.
The quotation shall state the unit basis used for maintenance pricing (per property, or per square metre).
Prices shall be quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not EUR per month.
Quotations shall be sent by email as a single PDF attachment.
The supplier's maintenance regime shall confirm that lift maintenance is carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection requirements.
The quotation shall describe the energy-efficiency measures the supplier proposes to implement or monitor at the three sites.
The quotation shall state the response time offered for fault reports and describe the standby (on-call) arrangement outside normal working hours.
The quotation shall describe the escalation procedure applied to faults that remain unresolved after the initial response.
The quotation shall describe how subcontractor costs are made transparent to the buyer, including any mark-up applied.
A current trade register extract for the supplier shall be included with the quotation.
The quotation shall be submitted using the Tender Form provided as Liite 1.
